notes: Scenario-2 parity uses Harbor's mini-swe-agent 2.2.8 with openai/gpt-5.4-mini through LiteLLM openai_chat_completions. Each side ran 3 full passes of the 12 scene-group tasks (270 queries). Primary metric is query-micro Hit@5 (score_sum / total_queries). Harbor run 3's agent trials finished, then the separate verifier was regraded with harbor jobs regrade after a Docker no-network probe failure; predictions were not regenerated. Offline rescore of all 36 Harbor predictions.json files against reward.json has max absolute difference 0. Sample SEM is stdev / sqrt(n). Complete 722-file parity and oracle artifact mirror: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Acture/motifbench-parity-experiments.
